sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: An evergreen shrub or small tree of East Asia, occurring in warm-temperate forests of Japan and South Korea.

sections.title: Leaves, flowers and fruit
sections.text: The leaves are glossy and the pale flowers appear in spring. The fruit is a star-shaped cluster of follicles that ripens in autumn or winter.

sections.title: Toxicity
sections.text: All parts are poisonous, especially the fruits and seeds, which contain neurotoxic anisatin. Do not confuse it with edible star anise (Illicium verum); the illustrated species must not be used as a spice.
